subject: accepted design authority
required_rule: exact SELECTED-PROVIDER-MATERIALIZER-DESIGN-ACCEPT-001 row and frozen object-plan digest must match

subject: contract rows
required_rule: exactly 41 contract rows are required

subject: materializer plan binding
required_rule: each accepted MAT-OBJ row occurs exactly once and no unknown plan row is present

subject: provider object identity
required_rule: provider_object_id and expected_member_sha256 are unique across all 41 rows

subject: candidate local paths
required_rule: candidate contract contains zero populated local_regular_file_path values

subject: future local map rows
required_rule: a future receipt must contain exactly 41 rows with the same contract_row_id set

subject: future local regular-file path
required_rule: path must be absolute canonical text with no dot dot component, glob, variable or search expression

subject: future local regular-file path set
required_rule: all 41 future local paths must be unique

subject: path provenance
required_rule: path must be supplied by a separately authorized localization receipt; recursive search and filename discovery are forbidden

subject: path traversal
required_rule: lstat every path component and reject symlinks; final open uses O_RDONLY O_CLOEXEC O_NOFOLLOW

subject: opened local object
required_rule: final lstat and fstat must both report a regular file

subject: local object owner
required_rule: st_uid must equal the read-only localization transaction uid

subject: local object mode
required_rule: group-write and other-write bits must be zero

subject: read stability
required_rule: device inode size mtime_ns and ctime_ns must remain identical before open after open and after hashing

subject: member byte size
required_rule: fstat size must equal expected_member_size_bytes

subject: member content digest
required_rule: streamed SHA-256 must equal expected_member_sha256

subject: ELF class machine and type
required_rule: member must be ELF64 little-endian AArch64 ET_DYN

subject: ELF SONAME
required_rule: DT_SONAME must equal expected_soname exactly

subject: retained result identity
required_rule: future localization receipt must bind expected_result_sha256 and expected_result_remote or accepted digest sentinel exactly

subject: result index identity
required_rule: result index kind and exact SHA or accepted existing-authority sentinel must match the contract

subject: container locator
required_rule: container class and exact container locator must match; no basename fallback is permitted

subject: member locator
required_rule: exact member locator must match with no absolute-to-relative rewriting or basename fallback

subject: atomic provider families
required_rule: AT-SPI2 Cairo Pango and GDK/GTK families must be present and valid as complete units

subject: receipt and failure semantics
required_rule: canonical compact UTF-8 JSON is digest-bound; any failed row rejects the whole map and produces no accepted local map
